author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic/character visual design collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for a December exhibition at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, and other exhibition collateral. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking hand-drawn, Japanese-inspired, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
